title: SSRF via user-supplied target_url in scan creation
description: The CreateScan endpoint accepts a target_url from the user without validating that it points to an external resource.
impact: Attackers could scan internal services and cloud metadata endpoints.
remediation: Validated URL using urlutil.ValidateExternalURL which blocks loopback, private ranges, link-local, and cloud metadata.

title: SSRF via user-supplied target_url in passive header checks
description: PassiveHeaderChecks made HTTP request without URL validation.
remediation: Added urlutil.ValidateExternalURL guard before making request.

title: SSRF via user-supplied URLs in BOLA probe
description: BolaProbe fetched user-supplied probe URLs without validation.
impact: SSRF to internal resources with attacker-controlled tokens.
remediation: Added urlutil.ValidateExternalURL check on each probe URL and host-matching validation.

title: SSRF via user-supplied target_url in load tests
description: Load test runner made HTTP requests to unvalidated target URLs.
impact: SSRF to internal services + DoS amplification.
remediation: Added urlutil.ValidateExternalURL and capped duration (<= 3600s), concurrency (<= 500), RPS (<= 10000).

title: Hardcoded JWT signing secrets in source code
impact: Complete authentication bypass via token forgery.
remediation: Removed DefaultTokenConfig hardcoded defaults. Enforced mandatory environment variables AUTH_ACCESS_SECRET and AUTH_REFRESH_SECRET with startup failure if unset or default.

title: No rate limiting on authentication endpoints
remediation: Added Redis-backed RateLimit middleware (10 requests/min per IP) to all auth endpoints.

title: ZAP Docker image configurable without validation
description: ZAP Docker image name loaded without regex validation.
impact: Potential container execution if config modified.
remediation: Use pinned image digest or strict image name pattern.

title: No security headers on HTTP responses
remediation: Added SecurityHeaders middleware setting X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, CSP, Referrer-Policy.

title: Account enumeration via login timing
description: User enumeration via bcrypt timing difference between found and non-found user.
source_trace: Login -> GetByEmail -> immediate return on error
remediation: Added dummy bcrypt hash comparison on user not found to normalize response timing.

title: No CORS configuration
remediation: Specify CORS policy when deploying with decoupled frontend.

title: Docker socket mounted in production container
remediation: Restrict Docker socket access or use Docker socket proxy.

title: SQL injection in scan store
description: All SQL queries use parameterized statements. No vulnerability.
